import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from observe_output import no_turn
import execution_receipt, ledger
r = lambda d: (json.dumps(d) + "\n").encode()
assert no_turn("claude", r({"type": "result", "num_turns": 0})) is True, "claude 0 turns"
assert no_turn("claude", r({"type": "result", "num_turns": 1, "usage": {"input_tokens": 5, "output_tokens": 5}})) is False, "claude 1 turn"
assert no_turn("codex", r({"type": "thread.started"})) is True, "codex no turn.completed"
assert no_turn("codex", r({"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 5, "output_tokens": 5}})) is False, "codex turn"
assert no_turn("cursor", r({"type": "result", "usage": {"inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0}})) is True, "cursor zero tokens"
assert no_turn("agent", r({"type": "result", "usage": {"inputTokens": 0, "outputTokens": 0}})) is True, "agent alias"
for p in ("claude", "codex", "cursor", "agy"):
    assert no_turn(p, b"") is False and no_turn(p, b"not json") is False, p + " missing output is not proof"
assert no_turn("agy", r({"type": "result", "num_turns": 0})) is False, "agy never"
assert "stalled" in execution_receipt.OUTCOMES and "stalled" in ledger.OUTCOMES, "outcome enums"
for path in ("schemas/execution-receipt.schema.json", "schemas/ledger-row.schema.json"):
    assert '"timed_out", "stalled", "interrupted"' in open(path).read(), path
src = open("scripts/execution_runner.py").read()
assert "STALL_EXIT = 123" in src and "NO_TURN_EXIT = 122" in src, "exit codes"
h = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "scripts/execution_runner.py", "--help"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
assert "--stall-seconds" in h and "--idle-seconds" in h, "runner flags"
w, b = open("scripts/spawn-worker.sh").read(), open("scripts/spawn-brain.sh").read()
assert '--stall-seconds "${SPAWN_WORKER_STALL_SECS:-90}" --idle-seconds "${SPAWN_WORKER_IDLE_SECS:-900}"' in w, "worker wrapper"
assert '--stall-seconds "${SPAWN_BRAIN_STALL_SECS:-90}" --idle-seconds "${SPAWN_BRAIN_IDLE_SECS:-900}"' in b, "brain wrapper"
print("ok")
